body.name: Algebraic \(p=1/2\) covariance-scope criterion
body.construction: For \(\mathcal C\in\mathfrak C_K(G)\), compute \(L_i(\mathcal C)=\ell_{\mathcal C}(N_G[i])\), \(m_{ii'}(\mathcal C)=|L_i(\mathcal C)\cap L_{i'}(\mathcal C)|\), and \(V(\mathcal C;\Sigma)=N_{\exp}^{-1}\sum_{i,i'\in U}2^{m_{ii'}(\mathcal C)+1}\Sigma_{ii'}\mathbf 1\{m_{ii'}(\mathcal C)>0\}\).
